items.title: fix(codex): keep the exec-server exit diagnostic at a UTF-8 boundary …
items.summary: fix(codex): keep the exec-server exit diagnostic at a UTF-8 boundary (#183932) fix(codex): cut the exec-server exit diagnostic at a UTF-8 boundary The Codex exec-server exit diagnostic truncated stderr in the middle of a multi-byte UTF-8 character, so CJK or emoji output near the limit ended in replacement characters. Truncation now stops at a character boundary. Evidence: the compiled node worker launched the registered Codex exec-server in a managed workspace with a real failing executable. On main the diagnostic had 1 replacement character for CJK and 3 for emoji (twice each); with this change none (twice each), still with exit code 3. ASCII and already-aligned output are unchanged. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183932#issuecomment-6443511499. Production 7 lines. Thanks @SunnyShu0925. Co-authored-by: SunnyShu Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: 美國CISA警告PHP2Shell遭到積極利用
items.summary: 上週PHP開發團隊公布及修補的重大漏洞CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619（統稱PHP2Shell）震驚全球，美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）在呼籲用戶立即修補相關弱點後，本週也掌握遭積極利用的證據並提出警告。

items.title: Brotli解壓縮漏洞也影響.NET，微軟緊急發布臨時更新修補
items.summary: 微軟10月25日發布.NET臨時（Out-of-Band）安全更新，緊急修補Brotli解壓縮漏洞。應用程式若解開攻擊者提供的惡意壓縮資料，可能讓未經身分驗證的攻擊者讀取或破壞程式記憶體，造成資料外洩、服務中斷或權限提升。此次更新也修補Linux封裝的檔案擁有權問題，並修正10月13日安全更新未完整處理的另兩項漏洞。
